description: This file contains code to train a custom object detection model using the ImageAI library, specifically configuring and initiating training of a YOLOv3 model for detecting 'hololens' objects.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsYOLOv3
methods.description: Configures the trainer to use the YOLOv3 model type.

methods.name: setDataDirectory
methods.description: Sets the directory containing training data.

methods.name: setTrainConfig
methods.description: Configures training parameters such as object names, batch size, number of experiments, and pretrained model.

methods.name: trainModel
methods.description: Starts the training process for the object detection model.
